answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can rest on a graded attestation graph. Each agent starts at a sparse vertex and must accumulate reciprocal verifications that form a coherent velvet of mutual work. An attacker spinning up clones faces the cost of sustaining a sable-dark cluster of coordinated activity long enough to fool the jury; isolated or low-quality vertices receive zero rewards and are pruned. One-shot key generation is cheap; sustained genuine interaction is not.
